alignments.note: Question marked by inversion alone ("Knowest thou"); no fronted auxiliary is written, so the particle is unrepresented under rule 17.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun under rule 17; head on the lexical verb.
Supplied determiner joins the noun it determines (rule 15).

Infinitive construct as nomen rectum of עֵת, recast as a finite temporal clause; the construct relation licenses "when" on the rectum (rules 19, 52). Discontinuous around the subject phrase (rule 25).

The ASV writes a bare "goats" for other Hebrew words of the class, so "goats" carries the lexeme and "wild" is its specifier (rule 31); supplied "the" joins the noun (rule 15). Heading on "wild" was the competing reading.
Construct relation "of" belongs to the rectum (rule 19); supplied "the" joins the noun (rule 15).
Verb with its supplied modal and subject pronoun (rule 17).

Infinitive recast as a finite clause; the supplied "when" is part of that recasting and stays with the infinitive, as rule 46 keeps a supplied relative with a recast nominal. Competing reading: "when" added under rule 55.
No conjunction morpheme stands in the clause, so the coordinating "Or" answers to nothing (rule 14, closing); the ASV italic corroborates it (rule 7).

review_notes: Both infinitives construct are recast as finite "when" clauses; the first takes its "when" from the construct relation with עֵת, the second from its own recasting.
